# `base/navigation-menu`

Site navigation needs grouped panels of links under top-level triggers.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Site navigation needs grouped panels of links under top-level triggers.
- **Avoid when:** The items are commands rather than destinations, or the shell owns the navigation.
- **Consider instead:** `base/menubar`, `layout/navigation`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { NavigationMenu } from "themelia-ui/base/navigation-menu"
import "themelia-ui/base/navigation-menu.css"
```

## Composition

This family has no component-family dependencies.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `NavigationMenu`

Kind: callable.

The bar, and the one panel every entry shares: each `NavigationMenuContent` is drawn into
its viewport, so moving between entries resizes one panel.

```text
({ className, children, side, sideOffset, align, container, ...props }: NavigationMenuProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `NavigationMenuContent`

Kind: callable.

One entry's panel content, drawn into the bar's shared panel while its entry is open.
Placement belongs to the panel, so it is set on `NavigationMenu`, not here.

```text
({ className, ...props }: NavigationMenuContentProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `NavigationMenuContentProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `NavigationMenuPrimitive.Content.Props`.

No own members are present in the normalized public snapshot.

### `NavigationMenuIndicator`

Kind: callable.

The caret inside a trigger, turning over while its panel is open. Renders a chevron;
pass children for another glyph.

```text
({ className, children, ...props }: NavigationMenuPrimitive.Icon.Props) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `NavigationMenuProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `NavigationMenuPrimitive.Root.Props`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `side` | no | `NavigationMenuPrimitive.Positioner.Props["side"]` | Where the panel sits relative to the bar. |
| `sideOffset` | no | `NavigationMenuPrimitive.Positioner.Props["sideOffset"]` |  |
| `align` | no | `NavigationMenuPrimitive.Positioner.Props["align"]` | How the panel lines up with the open entry. Defaults to `start`, so the first entry's<br>panel never hangs past the bar's leading edge. |
| `container` | no | `UIPortalContainer` | Where the panel renders. Defaults to the nearest `UIPortalHost`, else the primitive's own. |
